carmen: quick hit  deploy-bot's postdeploy smoke for rollout/2026-06-rerank-batched flagged a tail latency regression on /rerank and a small uptick in 500s during synthetic fanout :chart_with_upwards_trend:
deploy-bot: POSTDEPLOY SMOKE SUMMARY for rollout/2026-06-rerank-batched
```
status: marginal-fail
checks_run: [liveness, synth-rerank, kv-prefill, routing-checks]
rerank.p95: baseline=90ms -> observed=320ms (15m)
rerank.5xx: baseline=0.03% -> observed=0.4% (mostly backend 502/504)
observed-window: 09:12-09:27 UTC
notes: spike aligns with batched-synth fanout (concurrency bump).
```
sre-oncall: I'm seeing elevated connection queue sizes at the rerank proxy (eu-west). no host OOMs. traces: https://traces/int/xyz789 shows slow handoff from proxy->allocator.
cheng: do we have any in-flight prefill/backpressure metrics? could be head-of-line blocking from a few slow model instances.
ops-bot: metric snapshot attached to ENGREL-1180 (logs + synthetic payloads).
ayla: can we throttle synthetic fanout and re-run smoke quickly? if it's the synthetic workload causing queuing, we should reduce it while debugging.
carmen: yes, pause the synth fanout and hold the rollout. I'm going to mark rollout as "paused - investigate rerank tail".
deploy-bot: ACTION: rollout paused by carmen at 1970001205; synth fanout toggled to 0% by carmen at 1970001210
cheng: suggestion: run a targeted 2% canary to v4-rerank (no batching) to isolate whether batching changes latency. if canary stays green, the problem is batching/fanout.
sre-oncall: agree. also will bump proxy connection pool for rerank route from 50 -> 80 for canary namespace only to reduce queueing. will revert after test.
ayla: i'll prepare a minimal synthetic payload set (short and long prompts) and run it against canary. attaching sample curl: `curl -X POST /rerank -d '{"queries":["q1","q2"], "size":10}'`
carmen: release notes update (prod.release): "Paused rollout/2026-06-rerank-batched due to rerank p95 regression under batched synth fanout; synth fanout halted and canary plan scheduled. Will update ENGREL-1180 with results."
cheng: timeline: if 2% canary (with altered pool and no batching) looks stable for 20m, we re-enable a conservative batched-synth at 5% and watch for 30m. if not stable, rollback to v3-rerank for next cycle and open hotfix issue.
deploy-bot: NOTE: resume decision deadline set to 1970005011 (1h window)
sre-oncall: starting pool flip and canary now. I'll post trace links and p95s in ENGREL-1180.
ops-bot: tagging on-call pager for visibility: @sre-team :bell:
carmen: thanks all. keep comments in ENGREL-1180. I'll DM product with a short blurb so they don't amplify telemetry noise.
